Package com.thalesgroup.gemalto.d1.paymentpasskey

Class ConsumerInfo

java.lang.Object
com.thalesgroup.gemalto.d1.paymentpasskey.ConsumerInfo
public final class ConsumerInfo extends Object
Represents the consumer information for Payment Passkey operations.

This class encapsulates the consumer contact information that can be used during Payment Passkey enrollment and authentication flows. It supports two types of consumer identification:

  • Email-based: Using the consumer's email address.
  • Phone-based: Using the consumer's phone number with country code.

Usage Examples: 


 // Create ConsumerInfo with email
 ConsumerInfo consumerInfo = new ConsumerInfo("user@example.com");
 
 // Create ConsumerInfo with phone number
 ConsumerInfo consumerInfo = new ConsumerInfo("1234567890", "+1");
 
 // Update consumer information
 consumerInfo.setEmail("newemail@example.com");
 consumerInfo.setPhoneNumber("9876543210");
 consumerInfo.setPhoneNumberCountryCode("+44");
